name: Balena
tagline: Container-based edge fleet management for IoT devices
description: Balena provides an OpenAPI-based REST API for managing fleets of edge/IoT devices, including applications, device provisioning, releases, environment variables, and remote access. Developers use it to automate fleet operations, deploy containerized software, and monitor device state at scale.

auth.details: API key (session token or device API key) via Authorization: Bearer header; self-serve signup on balenaCloud

use_cases: get device online status and last seen
deploy a release to a fleet
SSH or tunnel to a remote device
